profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Comcast Effectv
profile.geoLocationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
profile.summary: I am a hard working motivated individual that possesses the ability to pick up new technologies and systems easily. My professional objective is to join a forward-thinking technology company that engages workers with challenging and rewarding work, including developing software applications that affect positive change in people’s lives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Full-stack developer for an external client facing self-serve application written with a Vue 3 frontend and mixed Spring Boot and Python backend. Lead team to implement test-driven development using Jest on the frontend and Junit, Mockito, and Pytest on the backend. Used SonarQube to enforce best practices. Implemented Typescript support.
-	Full-stack developer for an Angular application responsible for monitoring advertisement decisions placed on Comcast set-top boxes. Designed Java Spring Boot REST APIs. Implemented alerting system using event-driven architecture in AWS with SNS topics, SQS queues, DynamoDB and Lambdas.
-	Work closely with SCRUM leader and product team to analyze business requirements and convert them into user stories. Wrote technical design documents to communicate decisions with developers and stakeholders. 
-	Created internal workload and systems tracking application using Angular frontend and Java Spring Boot backend. Allows engineering managers to track 100+ employee workloads and export reporting metrics to upper management. 
-	Automated the deployment of Azure infrastructure using Terraform, including APIM, Python function apps, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Storage Accounts, and Cosmos DB. Deployed application infrastructure onto Kubernetes using Concourse CI pipelines. Incorporated static analysis into the pull-request process for all infrastructure changes.
-	Developed an internal application health monitoring tool with Slack integration for a Spring Cloud based application infrastructure. Employed Project Reactor and Spring WebFlux to implement a reactive-based programming approach.
-	Wrote AWS Glue Job to enrich advertising data points with internal ad decision data. Developed Spark Job on Kubernetes to migrate data from a Microsoft SQL Server into parquet files stored within AWS S3.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
Software Development
•	Developed administrative web dashboard application that consolidated dispersed branch reports and charts into one system. Python, Django, AJAX, HTML, Bootstrap, REST, Oracle, SQL Server
•	Maintained and added new functionality to legacy federal benefits non-receipt claim system according to requirements. Planned rewrite of system to take advantage of newer technologies to improve efficiency. Python, Django, AJAX, HTML, Bootstrap, REST, Oracle

Analytical Reports
•	Designed analytical reports to track and provide performance metrics to branch managers. On-boarded new team members in learning reporting tools and integrating with center databases via JDBC connections. HTML, CSS, Oracle, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Business Intelligence Reporting Tool (BIRT)
Post Payment System
•	Increased returned check processing capabilities 50% by bringing on line an industrial check scanner through trouble-shooting and coordinating file transfers with the Federal Reserve Bank. 
•	Defined returned check processing operations with diagrams and process flow documentation.

positions.title: IT Student Paid Intern
positions.description:
Software Development
•	Created mission-critical treasury check scanning software to allow for continued operations during equipment upgrades. Processed hundreds of returned federal payments sent to the Philadelphia Financial Center daily. Java, Eclipse, State Design Pattern

Computer Operations
•	Assisted with design of website and web graphics and helped IT department with computer operation functions.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Answered incoming calls and directed visitors. Helped organize a summer workshop for high school students.

positions.title: Summer Counselor
positions.description: Was part of a two-person counselor team that was charged with overseeing a group of young camp attendees and also a group of older attendees.

volunteerExperiences.role: President of the Board of Directors
volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Hansberry Garden and Nature Center, Inc.
volunteerExperiences.description:
As President of this 501©(3) non-profit community garden, I am charged with governing the board of the organization and playing a strong role in managing the general affairs of the garden. 

I provide leadership and guidance through the growing season and research and compose better ways to organize the membership and overall running of the organization.

company.name: The Hansberry Garden and Nature Center, Inc.

volunteerExperiences.description: Charged with assisting the Board Secretary in maintaining accurate reporting and creating accurate minutes.

projects.title: Garden Hero
projects.description: Garden Hero is under active development. The web application was launched through Code for Philly’s Civic Engagement Launchpad project. Garden Hero helps community gardens better cultivate a better gardening community by assisting them in manage their resources (donors, volunteers, plots, and memberships). The backend is written in Django.
